notable_components.src/app/HeroPackageSearch.tsx: landing-page search box (inside the light split hero since 2026-10-01, next to HeroTuneButton); uses src/services/packages.ts fetchPackageOptions()/filterPackageOptions() (f209)
notable_components.src/app/destinations/DestinationPlans.ts: live country plans view: CountryBanner, PlanFilterBar, PlanRow list, sticky PlansSidebar, CollapsedCountryBar; filter/sort in planList.ts (f213, f215)
notable_components.src/app/destinations/DestinationBrowse.t: destination directory section: Trending + 5 rails as TileCarousel/PhotoTile photo carousels, All destinations as CountryRow cards with search + Show all/Show less; owns the single Help Me Choose wizard (f150, f210, f211)
notable_components.src/app/components/Navbar.tsx: site nav: floating frosted capsule on every page (no theme prop since 2026-10-01); renders BottomDock as a sibling after </header>; profile icon is a STATIC link regardless of session state (f022) so public pages stay statically generated; below lg only logo + ☰ show (f207, f208)
notable_components.src/app/AdminNav.tsx: nav shared by hidden /xloginy and /xerrors admin pages
notable_components.src/app/components/BottomDock.tsx + dock: phone/tablet (<lg) app-style tab dock; pure rules isDockVisible()/activeDockItem() in dockNav.ts with tests; static links only (f207, f208)
notable_components.src/app/HeroTuneButton.tsx + destination: hero filter tile that opens DestinationBrowse's single wizard through a window event; requests never queue (f210)
notable_components.src/app/destinations/{TileCarousel,Photo: browse building blocks; photos lazy via IntersectionObserver + per-country promise cache (f211, f212)
notable_components.src/app/components/PlanRow.tsx + lib/pla: shared app-style plan row (live view, /pkg) and the rules/cell pieces the /esim table reuses; one gradient Buy per list (f213, f214)

data_shaping_layer.type: HeroPackageOption (as of 2026-08-15 also carries optional voiceMinutes/smsCount, undefined on data-only packages — f035)
data_shaping_layer.shared_mapper: mapPackagesPayload() in src/services/packages.ts, used by BOTH the browser fetch path and src/services/server-packages.ts (Server Components) so client and server renders of a plan are guaranteed identical (f023)
data_shaping_layer.normalization_helpers: formatDataLabel (GB/MB/'Unlimited' at >=999GB), formatDurationLabel, parsePriceNumeric (locale-ish string -> float), slugify (NFD strip diacritics), normalizeFilters
data_shaping_layer.search: filterPackageOptions(options, query, limit=10) does substring match against a precomputed lowercase `query` field concatenating country/title/data/duration/kind/region/filters

styling.fonts_loading: as of 2026-08-18 all three families are loaded via next/font/google in src/app/layout.tsx and applied as .variable classNames on <body> — before this fix the CSS variables were declared but nothing actually loaded the fonts, so every environment silently fell back to system fonts (f034)
styling.type_scale: mobile-matching scale added to tailwind.config.ts: display-lg (28px/34px), headline-md (21px/28px), title-sm (16px/22px), body-md (14px/21px), body-sm (12.5px/18px), label-caps (11px/14px, uppercase-tracking), mono-data (12.5px/18px) — see docs/design/mobile-design-system.md (f033)
styling.global_css: src/app/globals.css includes dark-theme support and a destination-image loader animation

google_button_layout_trap: Google Identity Services renders its button into a fixed-pixel-width iframe; a naive '[&>div]:!w-full' stretches only the wrapper, leaving the button itself left-aligned. Fix used: measure the row with a ResizeObserver and pass the real pixel width to renderButton (capped at Google's 400px limit), re-render on resize. Apple's button is built to match Google's fixed 40px pill height rather than the taller default Apple house button (source: docs/sessions/2026-08-13_social_signin_env_wiring.md).
i18n: No i18n library found in this repo (no i18next/next-intl in package.json); all copy is inline English (contrast with the velocity-eSim mobile app, which does use i18next per the root CLAUDE.md).
